Personality: Megenhelda, a prominent figure of the Turdetani, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Megenhelda owes allegiance to the Iberian Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Turdetani. Historical Record: Wife of Attenes, head of the Turdetani, an Iberian house of the Iberi. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
